quality_guards: Police.uk street and stop-and-search coordinates are approximate anonymised points, not exact incident locations.
Police API availability and latest-month values are dynamic and must be rechecked.
ONS Crime Survey and police recorded crime are separate sources with different coverage and interpretation limits.
Unreported or unrecorded offences are absent from police recorded crime.
Police-recorded trends may be influenced by recording practices, police activity and public reporting.
The fire release crosses the November 2025 IRS-to-FaRDaP collection transition and uses a revisable database snapshot.
Suffolk fire figures include a documented technical undercount for part of the period.
BSR registration and assessment charges are current service values and may change.
Building-safety duties apply to defined higher-risk buildings and are not evidence that an individual building complies.
RIDDOR and BSR mandatory occurrence reporting remain separate legal routes when both criteria apply.
2025/26 HSE fatality counts are provisional and scheduled for finalisation in July 2027.
Police, national crime, fire-service and workplace-fatality statistics are not converted into exact parcel-level probability.
V23 rows 101-120 were verified but not published after two safe attempts encountered concurrent canonical-branch head changes; no infinite retry or duplicate file was produced.
Current official-source verification does not replace 130-candidate/16-endpoint live parity, browser DOM/console acceptance, commit ancestry, publisher push or remote readback.
